Bumps [pyrate-limiter](https://github.com/vutran1710/PyrateLimiter) from 3.7.0 to 4.2.0.
Release notes

Sourced from pyrate-limiter's releases.

Release v4.2.0

What's Changed

  • Guard sync _delay_waiter against negative wait values from bucket backends by @​Copilot in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#278
  • fix(docs): align docstrings and fix: db_path=None temporary DB behavior by @​kaya70875 in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#279
  • Typo fix for pypi by @​tserrien in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#282
  • bug fix: Limiter initialization in README for SQLite by @​brian-pond in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#283
  • fix: add close() method to avoid ResourceWarning about unclosed transports by @​AmSach in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#280

New Contributors

  • @​kaya70875 made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#279
  • @​tserrien made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#282
  • @​brian-pond made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#283
  • @​AmSach made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#280

Full Changelog: https://github.com/vutran1710/PyrateLimiter/compare/v4.1.0...v4.2.0

v4.1.0

What's Changed

  • Update psycopg dependency to support macOS by @​Olegt0rr in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#258
  • Implement Postgres time retrieval in now() method by @​Olegt0rr in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#259
  • Fix strict type checker compatibility via explicit re-exports in __init__.py files by @​Copilot in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#266
  • tests: make Redis/Postgres tests optional for distro build environments by @​Enimalojd in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#264
  • fix: use absolute URL for Migration Guide link in README by @​Copilot in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#268
  • tests: skip test_limiter_async_factory_get when redis is unavailable by @​Enimalojd in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#271
  • Fix/sync timeout and docs v2 by @​Quintenvw in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#270
  • fix: make Limiter and BucketFactory pickleable by @​paultiq in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#272
  • Increase tolerances for timing-sensitive tests by @​JWCook in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#273

New Contributors

  • @​Olegt0rr made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#258
  • @​Copilot made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#266
  • @​Enimalojd made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#264
  • @​Quintenvw made their first contribution in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#270

Full Changelog: https://github.com/vutran1710/PyrateLimiter/compare/v4.0.2...v4.1.0

v4.0.2

Include missing docs & tests

What's Changed

  • Include docs and tests in sdist by @​vutran1710 in vutran1710/PyrateLimiter#256

Full Changelog: https://github.com/vutran1710/PyrateLimiter/compare/v4.0.1...v4.0.2

v4.0.1

Nothing, just the same as v4.0.0

v4.0.0: new api with improvment

What's Changed

... (truncated)

Changelog

Sourced from pyrate-limiter's changelog.

Change Log

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

[4.0.0]

Fourth major release with significant API simplification and breaking changes.

Breaking Changes

Exceptions Removed

  • BucketFullException and LimiterDelayException have been removed
  • Rate limiting now uses blocking behavior instead of exception-based flow control

Limiter Constructor Simplified

  • Removed clock parameter - each bucket now manages its own clock via bucket.now()
  • Removed raise_when_fail parameter - no exceptions are raised
  • Removed max_delay parameter - blocking is now controlled per-call
  • Removed retry_until_max_delay parameter
  • Added buffer_ms parameter (default 50ms) for clock drift tolerance

Clock Changes

  • TimeClock removed - use MonotonicClock instead
  • SQLiteClock removed - buckets now manage their own time
  • TimeAsyncClock renamed to MonotonicAsyncClock
  • Clock is no longer passed to Limiter; buckets have built-in now() method

try_acquire API Changes

  • New signature: try_acquire(name="pyrate", weight=1, blocking=True, timeout=-1)
  • blocking=True (default): blocks until permit is acquired
  • blocking=False: returns False immediately if bucket is full
  • Added try_acquire_async() for proper async acquisition with asyncio.Lock

Decorator API Changes

  • Old: limiter.as_decorator()(mapping_func)(target_func) where mapping returns (name, weight)
  • New: limiter.as_decorator(name="...", weight=...)(target_func) with direct parameters

BucketFactory Changes

  • schedule_leak(bucket, clock) now schedule_leak(bucket) - no clock parameter
  • create(clock, bucket_class, ...) now create(bucket_class, ...) - no clock parameter

New Features

  • Context manager support: with Limiter(...) as limiter: and with bucket:
  • limiter.close() method for resource cleanup
  • limiter_factory module with convenience functions:
    • create_sqlite_limiter()
    • create_inmemory_limiter()
    • init_global_limiter()

... (truncated)

Commits
  • cc552b8 fix: add close() method to avoid ResourceWarning about unclosed transports (#...
  • af67e1d bug fix: Limiter initialization in README for SQLite (#283)
  • a14fc76 removed an extra dash from pyproject toml pointing to readthedocs (#282)
  • 7b1010d fix(docs): align docstrings and fix: db_path=None temporary DB behavior (#279)
  • a2633c9 Guard sync _delay_waiter against negative wait values from bucket backends ...
  • bfc8c83 Increase tolerances for timing-sensitive tests (#273)
  • c81cd72 fix: make Limiter and BucketFactory picklable (#272)
  • 2c43434 Merge pull request #270 from Quintenvw/fix/sync-timeout-and-docs-v2
  • f008bdc tests: skip test_limiter_async_factory_get when redis is unavailable (#271)
  • fb554b8 Update pyrate_limiter/limiter.py
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view

> **Note** > Automatic rebases have been disabled on this pull request as it has been open for over 30 days.
